Name: Phoenix Expansion
Author: BrianOvaltine
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/many9Yo.png[/img]
This mod adds unique Phoenixes to your farm! This mod comes with a handful of unique variations. This mod is progressional, so unless you have met the right conditions, Phoenixes won't be available right away.

More variations unlock as you play and complete bundles. Bundles appear as a spell book inside the Phoenix coop. They are unlocked as you ship Phoenix Eggs. The first bundle is unlocked a day after you’ve shipped a red, blue, and green Phoenix egg. The second is a day after you’ve shipped a void, ashen, and radioactive egg. Third is a day after you’ve shipped a gold egg. The final bundle is a day after you’ve shipped an iridium egg.

Features custom animals, products, and artisan goods, with cut-scenes, letters, a new special order, and secrets.

Phoenixes live in the Phoenix Coop, buildable using the Wizards spellbook. They have a chance of dropping a feather instead of an egg after you've become friends with them. Eggs can be used for mayo or put into an incubator to hatch another phoenix.

The rarer the variation of phoenix, the more their animal product is worth.

Translations are welcome!
[list]
[*]Spanish translation by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/IdeaIntermedia/about-me]IdeaIntermedia[/url]﻿
[/list]

Please let me know if you encounter any bugs! I tried to test this as thoroughly as I could on multiple saves.

Should be compatible with any mod.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bzDC7fm.png[/img]
- Phoenix Coop
- Bundles for unlocking more Phonenix types
- New secret Phoenx types
- Nodes for specific Phoenix eggs
- New ways to get existing Phoenix types
- NEW EGG SPRITES - configurable using GMCM
- A new Void Phoenix color scheme inspired by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/softfragile/about-me?gameId=1303]softfragile[/url]'s Void Chicken - configurable using GMCM
- i18n for translations
- Mayo and Feathers are no longer needed for perfection
- More!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GjmyMRU.png[/img][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*]Unique gift tastes

[/list]
